name: Defias Tower Key
summary: At Klaven's Tower in Westfall, the Defias Tower Key proves an infiltrator reached the guarded perimeter. Stormwind operatives seek it from the malformed drones outside.

sections.title: A Prize from the Twisted Guard
sections.body: Klaven's Tower stands on the Westfall coast as a Defias Brotherhood stronghold. Recent shipments from Duskwood brought new guards to its perimeter: malformed Defias drones, undead and covered in spikes. SI:7 operatives watch the grounds and direct field agents to pick the pockets of these sentries. Fighting them head-on is not the way to prove the perimeter has been breached. The key shows an infiltrator got through without raising an alarm.

sections.title: Uncovering the Duskwood Connection
sections.body: The key leads to a chest inside Klaven's Tower, bound with shipments from Duskwood. The chest holds Klaven Mortwake's Journal. When the journal reaches Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind, it reveals a conspiracy beyond ordinary highway robbery. The Defias joined with the Venture Company to traffic specialized troll poisons discovered by Zanzil the Outcast. Those mixtures can raise the dead, explaining the grotesque, coughing abominations around the tower.

faq.q: How do you obtain the Defias Tower Key?
aliases: where do i get the key
how to get defias tower key
faq.answer: You must pickpocket one of the malformed Defias drones guarding Klaven's Tower in Westfall. The key cannot be taken from a defeated enemy.

faq.q: What does the Defias Tower Key open?
aliases: does it open the duskwood chest
faq.answer: The key does not unlock the tower door or the Duskwood Chest inside. Master Mathias Shaw requires it as proof that an operative infiltrated the perimeter undetected.

faq.q: What are the malformed Defias drones guarding the tower?
faq.answer: They are grotesque, spiked undead guards around Klaven's Tower. Agent Kearnen does not know what made them and asks operatives to investigate the shipment they guard.

faq.q: Who sends operatives to retrieve this key?
faq.answer: Agent Kearnen, an SI:7 scout watching Klaven's Tower's perimeter, directs field rogues to get the key and retrieve the Duskwood Chest's contents for Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

angles.text: As a rogue working with SI:7, you must use stealth and pickpocketing to acquire the Defias Tower Key, while keeping lethal poisons in mind.
As an Alliance member, you help Stormwind investigate the Defias Brotherhood's strange shipments from Duskwood by securing intelligence from Klaven's Tower.
